additional_info.subject: RE: 0403996 - ID0403996-DC/Si-D/FR-[h816g3] Operation Mode - Convterter Grouping CRM:00658000865
additional_info.body:
Hello Bastien,
Greetings of the day.
This charger has latest FW which has a feature of Power save mode, in this, charger opens Main breaker when not in use to reduce reactive power consumption.
When any customer wants to use this charger, it powers on all converter and at that time process will be as follows:
Power Save to Close Main Breaker to Request Serial Number to Converter Grouping to Running.
As of now, charger is working fine, and we have observed successful charging in last 24 hours.
Let us know if you have any other questions or can we close this ticket?
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav
